target_customer: Pet breeders, rehoming owners and pet buyers using a mobile video marketplace, starting in the UAE and moving to the UK
problem: Peer to peer pet listings use static photos on classifieds sites, so buyers cannot judge the animal and scams are common.
business_model: marketplace with in-app payments and pet services
product_category: Video first pet marketplace and social app

founders.name: Moustafa Mahmoud
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a 3x technical founder with 15 years in tech; details of earlier companies not found.

founders.name: Maha Refai
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio.

competitors.name: Traditional online classifieds such as eBay
competitors.what: Static photo peer to peer listings the company positioned itself against

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile video marketplace with payments uses standard components; video moderation and trust features add some work.

defensibility.rationale: A two sided pet marketplace can build liquidity but classifieds and generic apps can add video features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found in sources.

market_need_then: Pandemic era pet demand and scams in classifieds. The company reported rehoming over 6,000 pets and about 2 million dollars monthly GMV in November 2021 (company claims).

branding.domain_note: Uses camlist.com; the app store id is camelan, matching the YC slug, suggesting an earlier name Camelan (not sourced).
branding.community_and_virality: Launched an in-app community according to a Digital Journal release; no fan or meme evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shared with an unrelated camera app Camlist and other apps, little press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Camlist raised 1.3 million dollars pre-seed in November 2021 while claiming strong GMV growth and thousands of rehomed pets, and the YC directory still lists it as active with 5 people. No later round, exit or failure was found, so the company's path after 2021 is not public.
notes: The company website returned a 522 error when fetched, so site status is unconfirmed. Round of 1.3 million dollars is stated by Global Pet Industry (2021-11-26), FounderLodge (2021-11-25) and a TechCrunch headline; Seedtable dates it December 2021. One site names Quest Ventures, Pavilion Capital and Bent Pixels but calls it seed, unverified, so investors are left empty. Aggregators show a higher total of about 3.8 million dollars, unverified. Global Pet Industry says the company was founded in Dubai; the YC page lists London. Competitor list is thin; auto generated profiles named PuppyFind, AKC Marketplace and Petfinder but are undated.
